label: Diode
description: Allows current in one direction only. Used for rectification and clipping.

properties.label: Model
properties.hint: The real diode part this simulates — sets its forward voltage, leakage, and clipping character automatically.

properties.label: Forward Voltage (V)
properties.hint: The voltage it takes to turn this diode on and let current flow — this is what shapes clipping/distortion character. Leave blank to use the selected Model's real rating.

properties.label: Leakage (IR, µA) — optional
properties.hint: A tiny amount of current that sneaks through even when the diode is supposed to be off. Usually negligible — leave blank to use the Model's real rating.

over_current.message: Diode current exceeded its maximum rating and it burned out.

reverse_voltage.message: Reverse breakdown voltage exceeded. The diode failed.
